measurements.smoother: Centred W-column box average of the one-pass crossing residual about line_from_crossings; missing crossings are interpolated. Coordinates are shifted before m88lib.sfr_from_sites2.
measurements.aggregation: Median of 5 independently noisy frames; each planted cutoff's identical five noisy arrays are reused at every W.
measurements.selection_rule: Recommend only an intermediate contiguous block of at least two sampled W values where all three cutoffs are within 3% and each adjacent recovery changes by <=3%. Choose the sampled middle of the longest block. Truth is used only for the registered 3% bar; no isolated best-looking W is selected.
measurements.fallback: No safe plateau exists. Use W=inf (straight-line fallback) for the required synthetic reruns and freeze no finite W.

controls.headline: no common intermediate plateau; no finite W commissioned; synthetic reruns use straight-line fallback
